labels.name: Chache1
labels.description: 普通座驾叉车，驾驶位上方有护顶架，驾驶员坐着，前方有高门架和普通成对细长货叉；车身多为绿色或红色。

labels.name: Chache2
labels.description: 低位搬运车，车体小而低，驾驶员站着，前方伸出贴近地面的长双叉，无高起升门架和护顶架。

labels.name: Chache3
labels.description: 紧凑起重机车，车体较小，驾驶员站着，前方有明显竖直高门架及下部货叉，无驾驶位护顶架。

labels.name: Chache4
labels.description: 带大型专用属具的座驾叉车，驾驶员坐着，带护顶架和粗壮门架，前端装有醒目的黄色宽大搬运属具；车身通常为橙色。

labels.name: Qianyinche
labels.description: 单座位牵引车，车体低矮紧凑、外形圆润，带座椅和靠背，驾驶员坐着，无起升门架和成对货叉；车身通常为绿色。

plan.protocol: Five independent single-class queries per image, combined class-aware evaluation. No cross-class NMS; 100 candidates/class. short intentionally shares 叉车 for Chache1/4.

short.method: Class-aware bbox, score-ranked greedy one-to-one matching, COCO-style 101-point AP, all areas, no crowd/ignore. AP uses all confidence scores; score_threshold affects only precision/recall/F1 and proxy loss. Classes without GT excluded from mAP.

loss.definition: Hungarian mean normalized xyxy L1 + mean (1-IoU) + FP/(TP+FP) + FN/(TP+FN); weighted sum. Localization pairing is class-aware and does not require an IoU threshold. No backpropagation.

short.failure_policy: Failed requests contribute no predictions (GT remains); metrics are marked incomplete.
short.image_accuracy_policy: All evaluated images form the denominator, including inference failures. Correct requires a successful request, class-aware one-to-one matches for every GT box and zero FP/FN at configured IoU/score/max-detection settings. An inference failure is always an incorrect image, even for empty GT.
short.unlabeled_policy: Infer all images. Missing GT follows the configured policy: negative uses empty GT; skip excludes from metrics; error stops before inference.
short.negative_metric_policy: Image-level FP rate at score_threshold, capped per class; denominator excludes failed negative images. Failures are not true negatives and mark evaluation incomplete.
short.negative_error_policy: (Negative FP images + failed negative images) / all evaluated negative images. Every failed negative is an error and remains in the denominator.

diaowu.candidate_gt_coverage_policy: Diagnostic upper bound only: each GT has any saved candidate at IoU>=0.5; ignores one-to-one matching and ranking.

metrics.method: Class-aware bbox, score-ranked greedy one-to-one matching, COCO-style 101-point AP, all areas, no crowd/ignore. AP uses all confidence scores; score_threshold affects only precision/recall/F1 and proxy loss. Classes without GT excluded from mAP.

loss.definition: Hungarian mean normalized xyxy L1 + mean (1-IoU) + FP/(TP+FP) + FN/(TP+FN); weighted sum. Localization pairing is class-aware and does not require an IoU threshold. No backpropagation.

metrics.failure_policy: Failed requests contribute no predictions (GT remains); metrics are marked incomplete.
metrics.image_accuracy_policy: All evaluated images form the denominator, including inference failures. Correct requires a successful request, class-aware one-to-one matches for every GT box and zero FP/FN at configured IoU/score/max-detection settings. An inference failure is always an incorrect image, even for empty GT.
metrics.unlabeled_policy: Infer all images. Missing GT follows the configured policy: negative uses empty GT; skip excludes from metrics; error stops before inference.
metrics.negative_metric_policy: Image-level FP rate at score_threshold, capped per class; denominator excludes failed negative images. Failures are not true negatives and mark evaluation incomplete.
metrics.negative_error_policy: (Negative FP images + failed negative images) / all evaluated negative images. Every failed negative is an error and remains in the denominator.
